content.text: Drag a file into the editor, anywhere on or beside the page. An image shows as an image, and anything else becomes a tile to download. The image at the top is this page's header, set in Page look.
Select an image here to see it large.

attrs.alt: A blue river between green hills
attrs.caption: Large, with a caption

content.text: A file is stored with its page, moves with it, and counts for search.

A tile shows the type and the size of its file. Under Attachments, in the More actions menu, a file can be moved or copied to another page, and the tile keeps working. In the editor, the / menu offers File on this page, to show a file again without a new upload.
A small image can also stand in a line of text
